host_conditions.quiet_definition: Load averages are ordered 1/5/15 minutes. Every observed host sample: no other heavy.sh slot active and one-minute load below logical CPU count; CPU idle is a one-second sample; free memory excludes cache. Sampled at start, every five seconds, and end.
